correctness.rationale: Actual RESULT.md gives P_c(2cn)=c n^2+(floor(c/2)+2)n+1 by choosing c-parts. For nonsquare ab a Pell unit u^2-abv^2=1 yields positive integral T=[[u,av],[bv,u]] preserving bX^2-aY^2. As T has determinant 1 mod 2ab, a positive power is identity mod 2ab; its iterates carry (d_a,d_b) into congruences X=d_a mod 2a,Y=d_b mod 2b. Expanding the invariant yields exact equality of the two quadratic partition sections and strict growth gives infinitely many distinct positive solutions. Square-product a=sr^2,b=st^2 count O(H log H), so density follows. Independent calculation rederived 540 section values and symbolic T^T J T=J; checked the source verify_partition_pell.py arguments without relying on its logs. Boundary excludes a,b<3 and square ab; finite checks never used for infinity.
residual_risks: Finite checker does not establish an infinite or arbitrary-size theorem
